toolbar.search-hint: Search employees by name or document and press Enter

home.title: Welcome to Flowboard
home.content: Manage employees, areas, positions and the organization chart from a single source of truth.

about.title: About Flowboard
about.content: Flowboard is a human resources platform developed by Performily for growing Peruvian organizations.

page-not-found.title: Page not found
page-not-found.content: The path {{ invalid_path }} is not valid.

validation.min: The value must be greater than zero.
validation.futureDate: The date cannot be later than today.

employees.title: Employees
employees.summary: {{ active }} active, {{ terminated }} terminated and {{ suspended }} suspended.
employees.no-records: No record matches the applied filters.
employees.range: Showing {{ start }} to {{ end }} of {{ total }} employees
employees.no-results-content: Try removing some of the filters or search by name and document.

error.identity-document-taken: The document {{ number }} already belongs to {{ owner }}, with an active employment.
error.contract-end-date-required: A fixed-term contract requires an end date.
error.contract-end-before-hire: The contract end date cannot be before the hire date.

employee-form.new-subtitle: When saving, the system creates the credentials and sends the welcome email.
employee-form.edit-subtitle: Update the personal and employment data of the profile.
employee-form.step-errors: There are {{ errors }}. Fix the marked fields before moving on.
employee-form.invalid-fields: {{ count }} fields with an invalid format
employee-form.duplicated-document: an identity document that already belongs to an active employee
employee-form.documents-hint: Optional. You can attach the initial documents now or later from the employee file.
employee-form.on-save-2: The user is generated with the corporate email
employee-form.on-save-3: A temporary password is sent by email
employee-form.on-save-4: It must be changed on the first sign-in
employee-form.rules-personal: The identity document cannot repeat among active employees. If the person was terminated before, use the reinstate option instead of creating a new profile.
employee-form.rules-employment: The position must belong to the selected area. A fixed-term contract requires an end date. An employee cannot be their own manager and the hierarchy cannot have cycles.
employee-form.rules-documents: Only the document types of the catalog are accepted: PDF, JPG or PNG up to 5 MB each.
employee-form.rules-review: Check the data before saving. You can go back to any previous step to fix it.

employee-detail.salary-note: Flowboard shows the reference salary of the position. Payroll and payslips come from the organization's accounting system.
employee-detail.section-pending: This information will be available soon.

employee-documents.title: Employee file
employee-documents.subtitle: Documents of {{ name }}. Only Human Resources can access this file.
employee-documents.empty: There are no documents in the file.
employee-documents.retention: The file keeps the documents even after the termination, for the period required by labor regulations. Flowboard does not replace the custody of the physical original.

document-upload.title: Upload document
document-upload.drop: Drag the file or browse your computer
document-upload.hint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB

error.invalid-type: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files are accepted.
error.too-large: The file weighs {{ size }} and the limit is 5 MB. Compress it or upload it in two parts.

termination-dialog.title: Register termination
termination-dialog.info: The file and history are kept. The account can no longer sign in and the requests in progress are closed automatically. You can reinstate the employee later without creating a new profile.
termination-dialog.blocked-message: {{ name }} has {{ count }} employees who report to them. Reassign them to another manager before registering the termination: otherwise, those people would have no approver and their requests could not be routed.

error.before-hire: The termination date cannot be before the hire date.

reinstatement-dialog.title: Reinstate employee
reinstatement-dialog.info: The existing profile and its access account are reactivated, keeping the previous file. A new employment period starts on the reinstatement date.

status-dialog.title: Change status
status-dialog.info: A suspended employee keeps the profile but cannot use the platform until reactivated. To end the employment use Register termination.

manager-dialog.title: Assign direct manager
manager-dialog.cycle: {{ manager }} reports to {{ employee }}. Assigning them as manager would create a cycle in the hierarchy.

organization-chart.title: Organization chart
organization-chart.subtitle: It is built only from the direct manager declared in each profile. This hierarchy routes the approvals.
organization-chart.empty: There are no employees to display.
organization-chart.pending-hint: Active employees whose direct manager is no longer active.
organization-chart.rule: An employee cannot be their own manager and cycles are not allowed: if A reports to B, B cannot report to A or to anyone who depends on A.

organization-structure.title: Areas and positions
organization-structure.subtitle: They are modeled as data, not as code: creating an area or a position does not require deploying the application.
organization-structure.no-positions: This area has no positions yet.
organization-structure.salary-note: The minimum salary of the position is a reference for registering the assigned pay. Flowboard does not calculate or validate payroll amounts.

area-dialog.name: Area name
area-dialog.description-placeholder: What this area does in the organization

error.name-taken: An area with this name already exists. Area names cannot repeat.
error.has-employees: The area has active employees. Reassign them before deactivating it.

position-dialog.name: Position name
position-dialog.info: The minimum salary is a reference for Human Resources when registering the pay of each employee.

error.salary: It must be greater than zero.
error.title-taken: This area already has a position with this name.

benefits.title: Benefits
benefits.subtitle: Organization catalog and current assignments. The vacation balance is only updated when a request is approved.
benefits.no-benefits: There are no benefits with the selected filters.

error.name-taken: A benefit with that name already exists.
error.inactive-benefit: Only active benefits can be assigned.
error.no-active-employees: There are no active employees to assign the benefit to.
error.overlap: The employee already has this benefit in an overlapping period.
error.already-delivered: This assignment was already delivered. A delivery can only be registered once.
error.already-delivered-on: This assignment was already delivered on {{date}}. A delivery can only be registered once.
error.cancelled: The assignment was cancelled and its delivery cannot be registered.
error.cancel-delivered: A delivered assignment cannot be cancelled.
error.negative-balance: The available balance cannot be negative.
error.load-benefits: The benefits catalog could not be loaded.
error.load-assignments: The benefit assignments could not be loaded.
error.load-balances: The vacation balances could not be loaded.
error.create-benefit: The benefit could not be created.
error.update-benefit: The benefit could not be updated.
error.assign-benefit: The benefit could not be assigned.
error.register-delivery: The delivery could not be registered.
error.cancel-assignment: The assignment could not be cancelled.
error.adjust-balance: The vacation balance adjustment could not be saved.

benefit-dialog.name: Benefit name
benefit-dialog.description-placeholder: What it is for and who it applies to
benefit-dialog.has-balance-hint: Usage is deducted from the assigned balance.

assign-dialog.title: Assign benefit
assign-dialog.area-summary: It will be assigned to {{count}} active employees of {{area}}.
assign-dialog.area-skipped: {{count}} who already have it in that period will be skipped.

error.invalid-range: The end date cannot be before the start date.
error.quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero with up to 2 decimals.
error.overlap: {{employee}} already has this benefit assigned between {{from}} and {{to}}. There cannot be two assignments of the same benefit in the same period.
error.area-all-overlap: Every active employee of the area already has this benefit in that period.

error.before-validity: The delivery date cannot be before the start of the validity.

error.days: Enter a quantity greater than zero with up to 2 decimals.
error.reason: The reason is required: it stays in the history with your name and the date.

movements-dialog.title: Vacation movements
movements-dialog.empty: This balance has no movements yet.

vacation-balances.title: Balance per employee
vacation-balances.subtitle: Accrued and used vacation days. Manual adjustments are recorded with your name and the reason.
vacation-balances.no-balances: There are no balances with the selected filters.
vacation-balances.high-usage-count: {{count}} employees used {{percent}} % or more of their balance

benefit-assignments.empty: There are no assignments with the selected filters.

payroll.title: Payslips and payments
payroll.subtitle: Repository of payslips issued by the payroll system. Flowboard stores them and controls deposit status.
payroll.page-info: Flowboard does not generate or recalculate payslips. The file shown to the employee is exactly the one uploaded here.
payroll.range: Showing {{ start }} to {{ end }} of {{ total }} payslips

payment-dialog.title: Register payment
payment-dialog.info: The status changes to paid and the employee will see it on their payslip. The amount comes from the uploaded file and is not edited here.

observation-dialog.title: Observe payment
observation-dialog.info: The observation is visible to Human Resources in the payslip list. The employee does not see it; notify them through the usual channel if needed.

upload-dialog.title: Upload payslip
upload-dialog.description: Upload the PDF issued by the payroll system. The payslip starts under review and with a pending payment until it is published and the deposit is registered.
upload-dialog.info: Only PDF files up to 5 MB are accepted. The file amount is not recalculated.
upload-dialog.duplicate-title: A payslip already exists for this employee and period.

viewer.title: Payslip
viewer.description: Document uploaded by Human Resources. The platform shows the file exactly as uploaded: it does not generate, recalculate or apply deductions.

my-payslips.title: My payslips
my-payslips.subtitle: Only you can view these payslips. They are shown exactly as issued by the payroll system.
my-payslips.range: Showing {{ start }} to {{ end }} of {{ total }} payslips

wellbeing.title: Wellbeing
wellbeing.page-subtitle: Temperature, lighting and air quality readings, classified according to the thresholds defined by the organization.
wellbeing.stale-alert: {{ office }} has not reported readings for more than {{ hours }} hours. While there is no recent data, its indicator is not calculated: the space is shown as no data.
wellbeing.thresholds-note: Ranges are defined as data, not code. Changing them updates the classification of readings received afterwards.
wellbeing.empty-spaces: No spaces match the selected filters.

device-dialog.title: Devices · {{ space }}
device-dialog.subtitle: Link sensors that are in inventory. A device cannot be linked to two spaces.
device-dialog.linked-empty: This space does not have any linked devices yet.
device-dialog.inventory-empty: There are no devices available in inventory.
device-dialog.register: Register device in inventory and link
device-dialog.duplicate: A device with this code already exists.
device-dialog.already-linked: This device is already linked to another office.

history-dialog.title: History of {{ space }}
history-dialog.subtitle: Review a metric over time and distinguish a one-off episode from a persistent issue.
history-dialog.invalid-range: The range must be valid and cannot include future dates.
history-dialog.empty-title: No readings recorded in the interval
history-dialog.empty-content: Try another period or check whether the device has sent data.
history-dialog.summary: {{ count }} readings of {{ metric }} · Unit {{ unit }}

office-dialog.title: New monitored space
office-dialog.subtitle: Register the physical environment from which readings will be received. Flowboard does not provide sensors; it classifies the readings that are registered.
office-dialog.name: Space name
office-dialog.name-required: The name is required and must be at most 80 characters.
office-dialog.duplicate: A space with that name already exists in this organization.

threshold-dialog.title: Edit thresholds
threshold-dialog.subtitle: Ranges must cover the interval continuously, without gaps or overlaps.
threshold-dialog.note: Changes are effective for the classification of new readings.
threshold-dialog.error-invalid-ranges: Ranges must be contiguous, without gaps or overlaps.

errors.load: We could not load wellbeing information.
errors.generic: We could not complete the operation.

attendance.invalid-range: The start date is later than the end date. Correct the range to consult the history.
attendance.range: Showing {{ start }} to {{ end }} of {{ total }} records

empty.title: No records in the selected period
empty.content: No attendance mark was registered in the selected period. Try another date range or clear the filters.

summary.title: Summary by area
summary.subtitle: Period comparison. See where late arrivals are concentrated before talking with each manager.

records.title: Attendance
records.subtitle: Attendance records for the period. The platform records and classifies; it does not derive deductions or payments.

my.title: My attendance
my.subtitle: Only you can see this history. If a record is incorrect, submit a justification.
my.empty: There are no attendance records for the selected period.

justification.title: Justify absence
justification.upload: Drop the file or browse your computer
justification.note: Submitting creates a justification request. Your direct manager will review it and you can follow its status in My requests.

hours.title: Hours and overtime
hours.subtitle: Effective hours compared with the expected schedule for the position. Overtime is informational and does not automatically generate payment.
hours.note: Overtime is shown as the difference between registered effective hours and the expected schedule. Any compensation is managed outside Flowboard.

acting.label: Acting as
acting.hint: Temporary: there is no login yet, pick an employee to test the requester and approver screens.

inbox.title: Request inbox
inbox.summary: {{pending}} pending, {{waiting}} of them waiting for more than two days.
inbox.summary-empty: No pending requests. Resolved ones are still available in their tab.
inbox.empty-title: You have no requests to attend
inbox.empty-content: Everything that arrived is resolved. When an employee sends a new request, it will appear here.
inbox.no-results-content: Change or clear the filters to see more requests.

my-requests.title: My requests
my-requests.subtitle: Everything you sent, with its status and who has it now.
my-requests.review-note: Your approver asked for more information: "{{comment}}". Use Complete to send it again.
my-requests.empty-title: You have not sent any request
my-requests.empty-content: Vacations, leaves or permissions: send them from here and follow their status.

request-form.title: New request
request-form.subtitle: The form changes according to the type you choose. Each type defines its own fields.
request-form.upload-hint: PDF, JPG or PNG up to 5 MB
request-form.file-type: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files are accepted.
request-form.file-size: The file cannot be larger than 5 MB.
request-form.insufficient-help: You can reduce the period to {{available}} days or less, or ask Human Resources if a vacation advance applies.
request-form.not-found: The request does not exist or it is not yours.

balance-card.title: My vacation balance
balance-card.not-found: There is no vacation balance registered.

approver-card.title: Who will approve
approver-card.manager-note: It is assigned automatically, according to your direct manager in the organization chart. They will be notified when you send the request.
approver-card.hr-note: You have no active direct manager, so the request goes to Human Resources.

approve-dialog.title: Approve request
approve-dialog.info: The employee will be notified that the request was approved.
approve-dialog.info-vacation: When approving, the vacation balance is deducted immediately and the employee is notified.

reject-dialog.title: Reject request
reject-dialog.reason-required: The reason is required: it is recorded and the employee will read it.
reject-dialog.info: A rejection cannot be undone. If only information is missing, return the request for review instead.

return-dialog.title: Return for review
return-dialog.comment-placeholder: Tell the employee what to complete or attach
return-dialog.comment-required: The comment is required so the employee knows what to complete.
return-dialog.info: The request goes back to the employee without losing its history. When completed, it returns to your inbox with the same number.

cancel-dialog.title: Cancel request
cancel-dialog.message: This action cannot be undone. If you need the same days later, you will have to send a new request.
cancel-dialog.info: You can cancel only while the request is pending or under review. Once resolved by the approver, it is no longer possible.

request-types.title: Request types
request-types.subtitle: Each type defines its fields, whether it requires an attachment and whether it deducts a balance. Adding one does not change the system.

request-type-form.title: New request type
request-type-form.subtitle: Define the behavior and the fields. Nothing has to be deployed: the employee form is built by itself.
request-type-form.name: Type name
request-type-form.requires-attachment-hint: The employee must upload a supporting file to send it.
request-type-form.deducts-balance-hint: When approved, it subtracts days or units from the chosen balance.
request-type-form.vacation-hint: Use the keys startDate and endDate so the requested days are calculated.
request-type-form.key-hint: The key is generated from the label. Use {{keys}} to build the period of the request.
request-type-form.fields-required: The type needs at least one field.
request-type-form.preview-hint: This is what the employee will see when choosing this type.

request-error.already-resolved: The request is already resolved or in another status, so this action is not possible.
request-error.not-assigned: You are not the approver assigned to this request.
request-error.not-owner: Only the employee who sent the request can do this.
request-error.not-under-review: Only a request under review can be sent again.
request-error.attachment-required: This type of request requires a supporting document.
request-error.insufficient-balance: You do not have enough balance. You have {{available}} days and you are requesting {{requested}}.
request-error.balance-not-found: There is no vacation balance registered for you. Contact Human Resources.
request-error.period-end-before-start: The end date cannot be before the start date.
request-error.period-end-time-before-start: The end time must be after the start time.
request-error.field-key-invalid: The key must start with a lowercase letter and only use letters or numbers (2 to 50).
request-error.field-key-duplicated: The key {{key}} is already used in this type.
request-error.type-duplicated: A request type with that name already exists.
request-error.type-in-use: {{name}} has requests, so it cannot be deleted. You can deactivate it instead.

my-profile.update-note: Human Resources updates your personal data. Send an update request and attach the supporting document.
my-profile.not-found: We could not find your employee profile.

employee-benefits.title: Assigned benefits
employee-benefits.empty: This employee has no assigned benefits yet.

vacation-card.title: Vacation balance
vacation-card.empty: This employee has no vacation balance yet.
